item.tib: sprul sku blo ldan snying po'i snyan rgyud sgra bla spyang zhon nag mo'i sgrubs thabs cha lag rin chen phreng ba
item.coloph: ces ma cig sgra bla'i rgyal mo'i sgrub gzhung la nyer mkho'i cha lag tshogs mchod 'di ni/ gung btsun dpal ldan tshul khrims ber btsun bstan pa 'od zer nor bzang bkra shis don 'grub sogs kyis lha rdzas dang rtsi bcud kyis mtshams sbyar nas yang nas yang du bskyal ba'i ngor/ bdag 'dra snyigs ma'i sngags 'chang dbal 'bar stag slag can (gyis) slar me rta chu bstod (stod) zla ba'i dmar phyogs dam can 'du ba'i nyin par bkra shis pa'i dge mtshams (mtshan) dang bcas te/ dben gnas man Dal ri khrod kyi yang dben seng ge g.yu phug nang du thol shar bris du bris pa'o//
